summary: Iran is advancing underground missile production at Khojir while nuclear negotiations with the U.S. show partial progress but persistent distrust. Lebanon faces intense daily bombardment with 47 artillery strikes and 8 air strikes across southern districts on October 31. Hamas tunnel footage reveals the full General Military Council that planned the October 7 attack, all now confirmed killed.
key_points: Excavation for a new entrance at Iran's Khojir underground missile facility indicates ongoing rehabilitation and a shift of production underground. (Source: @shin_persian/11814)
U.S. CENTCOM reports 144 commercial vessels redirected by October 31 while enforcing the blockade against Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/11811)

AP investigation finds over 115 Iranian strikes damaged structures at 26 U.S. military sites through August, initially targeting EW radar then aircraft and facilities; Kuwait heavily affected. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9265)
Iranian Army spokesperson confirms purchase of Russian Su-35 fighter jets, delivery after war ends. (Source: @shin_persian/11818)
Iran's SNSC Secretary Mohsen Rezaei acknowledges receipt of letter from U.S. VP JD Vance, states Iran discussing nuclear doctrine change if another war occurs. (Source: @yediotnews25/137070)

Lebanon daily report October 31: 193 alerts, 99 drone sightings, 1 drone strike (100% targeting rate), 8 air strikes, 47 artillery shelling incidents across Tyre, Nabatieh, Bint Jbeil districts. (Source: @redlinkleb/50904)

Al Jazeera releases rare footage of Hamas General Military Council planning October 7 attack; all members subsequently killed by Israel including Mohammed Deif, Raad Saad, Mohammed Sinwar, Marwan Issa. (Source: @yediotnews25/137056)
Explosion reported in Damascus, Syria; Kurdistan Peshmerga fulfills Pentagon MOU, U.S. financial assistance ended September. (Source: @shin_persian/11817, @Faytuks_Network/9258)

sections.executive_summary: Iran is advancing underground missile production at Khojir while nuclear negotiations with the U.S. show partial progress but persistent distrust. Lebanon faces intense daily bombardment with 47 artillery strikes and 8 air strikes across southern districts on October 31. Hamas tunnel footage reveals the full General Military Council that planned the October 7 attack, all now confirmed killed.

points: Excavation work to open a new entrance has been identified at the underground facility in Khojir, linked to Iran's missile production program, as part of ongoing rehabilitation and upgrades, consistent with assessments that Iran is moving production underground to replace aboveground facilities not yet restored. (Source: @shin_persian/11814)
U.S. forces have redirected 144 commercial vessels as of October 31 while enforcing America's blockade against Iran, according to CENTCOM. (Source: @shin_persian/11811)

An AP investigation found more than 115 Iranian strikes damaged structures at 26 U.S. military sites through August; Iran initially targeted EW radar, then aircraft and facilities, with Kuwait suffering particularly. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9265)
Iranian Army spokesperson Amir Akraminia stated Iran has purchased Russian Su-35 fighter jets, saying the aircraft will be delivered after the war ends. (Source: @shin_persian/11818)

Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council Mohsen Rezaei confirmed he read a letter from U.S. Vice President JD Vance but has not replied; he said Iran is discussing changing its nuclear doctrine in case of another war, but no official decision yet. (Source: @yediotnews25/137070)

Rezaei described nuclear negotiations: the second proposal was better than the first but an explicit message was conveyed; Foreign Minister Araghchi told counterparts Iran suspects they want to negotiate then attack after elections; the third response was much better, showing Americans willing to accept Iran's seven conditions; still some unclear points, answers conveyed to Araghchi yesterday, new round of discussions started. (Source: @N12chat/232602)
A single UAV was observed over Sanandaj at 00:30 local time (2100Z) in Kurdistan Province, Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/11822)

IDF reported yesterday (Friday) unexploded ordnance located in the Ramot Ramez area in northern Israel; military police isolated the scene and bomb disposal teams are neutralizing; the area declared a closed military zone to prevent civilian access. (Source: @yediotnews25/137063)
Protesters in Lyon, France, burned Israeli and U.S. flags during demonstrations. (Source: @N12chat/232605)
American and Israeli strikes have damaged or destroyed 7,645+ buildings according to a TankerTrackers report. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9269)
Fighter jet activity over south Lebanon indicated by Red Alert live map. (Source: @redlinkleb/50837)
Artillery shelling reported in Wadi al-Hajir, Hariss, and Hadatha areas per Red Alert live maps. (Source: @redlinkleb/50899, @redlinkleb/50915)

Al Jazeera published rare footage from Hamas tunnels showing the General Military Council (equivalent to their general staff) planning the October 7 attack and underground operations; all council members — brigade commanders and chiefs of staff — sit on floor mats in two rows, only Mohammed Deif sat on a bed at the head; every senior Hamas figure appearing in the footage has been killed by Israel during the war: Mohammed Deif, Raad Saad (architect of 'Jericho Wall' plan), Mohammed Shabana, Mohammed Sinwar (killed together in tunnel under European Hospital in Khan Younis), Marwan Issa (Deif's deputy), Ahmed Ghandour, Ayman Nofal (brigade commanders killed early), Raafat Salama (killed with Deif), Azz al-Din al-Haddad (third military wing chief killed), Mohammed Ouda (fourth military wing chief killed), and others; photo dated before May 2021 because Bassem Issa (North Gaza brigade commander killed in 'Guardian of the Walls') appears. (Source: @yediotnews25/137056)
American and Israeli strikes have damaged or destroyed 7,645+ buildings in Gaza per TankerTrackers. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9269)
A trash fire in an open area in Umm al-Fahm spread to a minibus; firefighters contained the blaze and the waste pile poses no danger. (Source: @yediotnews25/137067, @N12chat/232595)
